info.title: v2.livestream.get_session_detail
info.description: Get basic information about the live streaming room, including cover, title, description, type (test live or normal live), create time, update time, stream url, etc. (For TW, ID, TH, PH, MY, SG, VN)

values:
<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/livestream/get_session_detail?access_token=access_token&partner_id=partner_id&session_id=6236215&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp&user_id=user_id',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'GET',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;

x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The cover image URL of the livestream session.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The status of the livestream session, the enumeration values are as follows: 0 - Initial 1 - Ongoing 2 - Ended

x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The share link of the livestream session.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: create_time
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The creation time of the livestream session. It's unix timestamp in seconds.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: update_time
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The update time of the livestream session. It's unix timestamp in seconds.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: start_time
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The start time of the livestream session, 0 if session is not started yet. It's unix timestamp in seconds.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: end_time
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The end time of livestream session, 0 if session is not ended yet. It's unix timestamp in seconds.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: push_url
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The push stream url for the livestream session.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: push_key
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The push stream key for the livestream session.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: play_url
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The pull stream url of the livestream session.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: domain_id
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The identifier of the stream domain, need to be passed in request for v2.livestream.start_session.
